Join the U.S. Commercial Service [ https://www.trade.gov/us-commercial-service ] for the *Global Diversity Export Initiative (GDEI) Trade Mission to India, Singapore, and Hong Kong*. The mission is focused on expanding export opportunities for U.S. businesses that are founded, led, operated, or owned by members of underserved communities from industries with growing potential in India, Singapore, and Hong Kong.*

This unique mission will host the ""Export Markets Providing Opportunities for Women’s Economic Rise (EMPOWER) Asia Business Conference"" in Bengaluru on March 3-4, then mission participants will have the option for up to three trade mission stops in India (Bengaluru), Singapore, and/or Hong Kong to meet potential partners pre-screened by in-country U.S. Commercial Service staff.

Updates for you as a borrower on SAVE

Earlier this year, a federal court prevented the U.S. Department of Education (ED) from implementing parts of the Saving on a Valuable Education (SAVE) Plan and other income-driven repayment (IDR) plans. ED is currently prohibited from using the SAVE formula to calculate monthly payments and from forgiving loans after years of payments under the SAVE, Pay As You Earn (PAYE), and Income-Contingent Repayment (ICR) Plans.
